figures.caption: Word lanes and their changed-word count at the step-five checkpoint. The views come from two Debug launches with the same source and input.
figures.alt: Three annotated debugger details at video_group_counted, before its nop. Callout 1 marks the next instruction. Callout 2 shows w2 as four 32-bit lanes, numbered zero through three from left to right: 0x00000000, 0x00000088, 0x00000000, 0x00010000. Only lanes one and three are nonzero. Callout 3 shows v1 equal to two. The next pointer-advance region is still unfinished.

figures.caption: A delta record accepted at the publication checkpoint. Three Debug launches show the same source, input and suspension point.
figures.alt: Four annotated native IDE details at record_published, before its nop. Detail 1 marks the next instruction. Detail 2 shows the accepted 64 by 64 frame as repeating diagonal color bands. Detail 3 shows the context as little-endian low/high 32-bit word pairs: retained capacity 16384, next sequence 2, retained period 4, accepted kind 1, active bytes 16384, and the retained A5 suffix. Detail 4 shows success v0 equal to zero and v1 equal to 16384 bytes.

figures.caption: An accepted eight-frame file at the index-publication checkpoint. Three Debug launches show the same source, input and suspension point.
figures.alt: Four annotated debugger details at index_published, before its nop. Detail 1 marks the next instruction. In this little-endian run each 64-bit memory value appears as its low 32-bit word followed by its high word. Detail 2 shows eight directory offsets in decimal: 24, 12328, 12355, 12395, 12415, 24719, 24752, 24775. Two leading and two trailing A5-pattern words are retained outside the active entries. Detail 3 begins with retained scratch capacity 16384, then published frame count 8, period 4, duration 40 milliseconds, file bytes 24795 and directory entries 8. Detail 4 shows v0 equal to zero and v1 equal to 64 bytes.

figures.caption: An independent seek to frame six. Three Debug launches show the same source, input and publication checkpoint.
figures.alt: Four annotated IDE details at seek_published. Detail 1 marks the next instruction. Detail 2 shows the reconstructed 64 by 64 target picture. Detail 3 shows little-endian low/high word pairs: scratch capacity 16384, target 6, full-frame replay start 4, replay count 3 and retained A5 suffix fields. Detail 4 shows success v0 equal to zero and v1 equal to 16384 image bytes.

figures.caption: A mandatory full record at sequence zero. Four Debug launches inspect the same source, input and delegated-call return checkpoint.
figures.alt: Five annotated IDE details at dr_full_return. Detail 1 marks the next instruction after the full encoder returns. Detail 2 shows the source picture as a dark colored grid. Detail 3 shows the unaligned output bytes: three leading A5 guard bytes, kind zero, reserved zero bytes, sequence zero, payload length 0x3000, CRC 0x1d196e30, then RGB triples beginning 12 34 57 and 12 35 57. Detail 4 shows retained previous-image pointer and capacity, published kind zero and count 0x3010, retained A5 reserved field and scratch pointer. Detail 5 shows success v0 zero and v1 12304 record bytes.

figures.caption: Completed playback with the real IDE clock. Three Debug launches reach the same checkpoint; the lateness values belong to the context view.
figures.alt: Four annotated IDE details at vp_published. Detail 1 marks the next instruction after final publication. Detail 2 shows the last accepted 64 by 64 picture. Detail 3 shows little-endian low/high word pairs: eight accepted pictures, 8 late intervals, maximum lateness 132 milliseconds, and scheduled logical duration 320 milliseconds. These are actual host-clock observations, not the scripted zero-lateness example. Detail 4 shows success v0 equal to zero and v1 equal to eight accepted pictures.
